{{Spell InfoBox|image=3111.png|type=Spell Boost|rarity=Epic|misc_a_1=It increases the ignition buff for projectiles or summoners, lasting for 2 seconds and dealing 220 damage per sec.}}

'''[[Core of Flame]]''' is a [[Epic]] [[Spells|Spell]] of Type: Spell Boost. It increases the ignition buff for projectiles or summoners, lasting for 2 seconds and dealing 220 damage per sec.

'''Description:''' When there are multiple elemental enhancements, it randomly selects one color for appearance, but still produces the effects of all elemental enhancements when hitting a target.
